decision.explanation: Two distinct sources (D1S2 and D3S2) provide conflicting but specific claims about the location of Super Bowl 2021. Both assert the event will be at Raymond James Stadium, but with different cities (Glendale, Arizona vs. Tampa, Florida). These are treated as distinct valid referents under the same venue name. The Las Vegas reference (D2S1) pertains to Super Bowl LVIII and is unrelated to Super Bowl 2021, thus it is excluded.
